cues.text: A back alley behind the station, with rough-looking teenagers in small groups. You, Yukari and Junpei walk in, and the nearest ones turn to look.
A punk punches Junpei in the stomach.
Yukari kneels by Junpei. The punk calls out.
The punks back away and hurry off. Junpei turns to the young man.
Shinjiro walks away down the alley.
